purpose: Frozen data-generating-process regimes for Gate 0A. The result of a compression comparison is entirely determined by where causal signal sits relative to the genotype variance/LD spectrum, so the regime set is pre-registered before any run and each regime is decided SEPARATELY.
trait_model: y = g + e ; h2 = Var(g) / (Var(g) + Var(e))
genetic_value_available: g is known by construction and is the primary decision target (see R2_genetic)
polygenic_background: every regime carries a diffuse polygenic background in addition to its named causal component

major_LD_aligned.causal_placement: SNPs loading heavily on the leading block PCs / strong LD directions
major_LD_aligned.expectation: PCA-favorable; a regime where linear reconstruction compression should look good

spectral_tail.causal_placement: SNPs in the low-variance spectral tail, orthogonal to the leading block PCs
spectral_tail.expectation: ADVERSARIAL and the PRIMARY decision regime: unsupervised reconstruction optimizes genotype variance, which has no reason to align with trait-causal directions; this regime asks directly whether spectral compression discards phenotype signal while keeping LD

low_MAF.expectation: tests whether MAF standardization vs raw-centering changes what survives compression

within_block_interaction.causal_model: y includes gamma * G_i * G_j for SNP pairs inside one block, plus polygenic background
within_block_interaction.note: a linear ridge cannot read out an interaction from any representation; the interaction head is applied identically to every arm

between_block_additive.causal_model: y = beta_A G_A + beta_B G_B for SNPs in distant blocks
between_block_additive.expectation: DISTRIBUTED POLYGENIC, explicitly NOT long-range interaction; tests whether per-block compression loses additive signal spread across blocks

between_block_interaction.causal_model: y includes gamma * G_A * G_B across distant blocks, plus polygenic background
between_block_interaction.expectation: the TRUE long-range test and the only regime that is direct evidence for cross-block (Grassmann-style) structure

matched_interaction_head.definition: for interaction regimes the downstream is ridge on the degree-2 polynomial expansion of the k-dim representation (its coordinates plus all pairwise products), fit identically for every arm
matched_interaction_head.rationale: expressive enough to recover an interaction the representation preserved, and identical across arms so it cannot advantage one; a representation that discarded the interacting factors will fail here, which is the intended signal
matched_interaction_head.dimension_cap: pairwise-product dimension capped by the representation budget; recorded in the cost ledger

exploratory_regimes_secondary_only.common_causal: additive on common variants; MAF-axis companion to low_MAF
exploratory_regimes_secondary_only.high_LD_vs_low_LD: additive on high- vs low-LD SNPs; LD-axis sensitivity

traits_per_regime.note: the number of independent simulation replicates (seeds) per regime is fixed by the DETECTABILITY_GATE before the decision run; 20 is likely underpowered at h2=0.05, N~2247
